We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
 About You 
 As Senior Manager of Web & AI Experience, you’ll be at the forefront of crafting compelling digital experiences for our customers, partners, and stakeholders. All stakeholder experiences begin on our website and you will curate the front door to AppDirect and our subsidiary brands: from ensuring prospective customers can find us to how they find themselves in the experiences you’re building for them.
 You’ll blend strategic thinking with hands-on execution—some days building a roadmap that balances business priorities with team capacity, other days diving deep into technical challenges or enabling others to bring their ideas to life through vibe-coded solutions.
 You’ll lead a small, agile web dev team responsible for end-customer and partner experiences that start on our website. You’ll transform your team into having an AI-first mentality— from embedding AI into customer experiences to accelerating your team’s outputs with AI. You will leverage AppDirect’s proprietary AI platform ( devs.ai ) and leading vibe-coding environments to unlock the creative and technical potential of technical and non-technical teams and accelerate our overall time-to-market.
 This role is highly cross-functional. You’ll collaborate closely with other marketing teams, technical teams, product, and leadership to deliver measurable, strategic outcomes. You’re not just keeping up with technology—you’re pushing it forward.

 Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of AppDirect's corporate website and cornerstone sales and marketing applications, ensuring alignment with business goals and measurable outcomes.
 Lead AI integration across the team's workflows — identifying, testing, and implementing tools for development acceleration, content generation, prototyping, and UX personalization.
 Drive LLM-aware content (AEO/GEO) and SEO strategy, ensuring digital content is discoverable by both human audiences and AI systems.
 Manage and mentor a team of web developers working with the latest AI & Web technologies (we are largely tool agnostic) , setting performance standards and supporting professional development.
 Partner with design and UI teams to evolve our component library and design system, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and responsiveness across all digital touchpoints.
 Improve site performance through technical optimization, structured data, experimentation, and conversion testing.
 What we're looking for 
 5+ years of experience leading web strategy or design, or digital product management, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.
 Hands-on experience with common web technologies like React, Next.js, web infrastructure, vibe-coding tools, and database/CMS systems.
 Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into development or content workflows, including LLM-driven coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Lovable, or devs.ai).
 Proven experience with technical SEO, performance optimization, structured data, and LLM-aware content strategies.
 Experience managing technical teams and driving cross-functional initiatives with product, design, and marketing stakeholders.
 Strong communication skills — because this role requires translating complex technical decisions into clear direction for non-technical partners and senior leadership.
 Comfort with ambiguity and iterative ways of working — because the AI landscape shifts quickly and this role requires continuous evaluation and reprioritization of tools and approaches.

THE ROLE

Ashby's GTM engine runs on a set of interconnected systems. Keeping them accurate, efficient, and trusted is the foundation everything else is built on. As our GTM Systems Analyst, you'll own the daily maintenance and configuration of technical layer that powers our Go-to-Market organization: the CRM configurations, integration architecture, and data quality practices that let our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams move fast with confidence.

This role sits within Revenue Operations, the horizontal function that makes the entire GTM system work. You'll be embedded in daily operations (triaging issues, implementing new tooling, and translating business requirements into scalable configurations) while also contributing to longer-term systems strategy as we move up-market and expand our product suite.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS NOW

We're in an active expansion phase: new products, new segments, new GTM motions. Our systems need to keep pace. The person in this role will shape how we build the technical foundation for the next chapter of Ashby's growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - System Administration: Own the day-to-day health of our core GTM platforms. You'll manage configuration, user permissions, custom objects, and workflow automation across our CRM stack — making sure the systems actually reflect how our teams work, not just how they were set up two years ago.

 - Integration Support: Maintain clean data flows across our GTM toolset ( including intent data, conversation intelligence, and sales engagement platforms). You'll be the person who knows how signals travel between systems and why, and who makes sure they're flowing reliably.

 - Data Governance: Enforce standards for data quality, deduplication, and field taxonomy. Revenue reporting and forecasting are only as good as the data underneath them, along with our GTM Engineers and our System Architect, you'll build the infrastructure of trust that makes those outputs credible.

 - Stakeholder Support: Be the go-to technical partner for frontline GTM teams. You'll triage issues, gather business requirements, and deliver solutions that scale. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners and know when to say "that requires a bigger conversation" rather than patching around a root cause.

 - Tooling Evaluation: Help evaluate new GTM tech and AI tools as our needs evolve. You'll assess how new tools will integrate with our existing systems, support contract renewals, and support implementation of emerging solutions, with a practical bias toward what will actually get adopted and maintained.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Advanced proficiency in CRM administration: Salesforce Administrator or HubSpot Administrator certification strongly preferred

 - Experience connecting marketing automation, CRM, and revenue intelligence tools (e.g., 6sense, Gong, Outreach, Gainsight)

 - Ability to translate abstract business goals into documented, scalable technical configurations

 - Strong analytical skills: you can diagnose data discrepancies, form a hypothesis, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Instinctive troubleshooter:  you don't wait for a problem to be fully described before you start hypothesizing

 - Clear written communicator; we're a remote-first company and documentation is how work gets shared

 - 2–4 years in a RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Sales Ops systems role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with SQL or data warehouse querying (Snowflake, BigQuery) for ad hoc analysis

 - Experience with AI-assisted workflow automation or prompt-based tooling in a GTM context

 - Exposure to multi-product or multi-segment GTM motions
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You have used CRM systems extensively, but have not owned CRM administration work directly. Hubspot is our current CRM.

 - You prefer strategy and architecture work over hands-on systems ownership.

 - You do your best work when requirements are fully specified, rather than when you need to diagnose ambiguous issues and triage incoming requests.

 - You are looking for a role focused on one GTM function, rather than broad partnership across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Recruiter Screen

 2. Hiring Manager Interview

 3. Challenge Interview

 4. Final Round with multiple key stakeholders

ABOUT THE ROLE  
 We are a venture studio. We research and validate ideas in-house, then bring in an Entrepreneur in Residence to turn the strongest of them into real companies. Each venture starts with a clear thesis, a budget and a small team already in place. 
 As EIR , you lead one venture from early build to a standalone business. You work with a small  cross-functional team across product, growth, sales and engineering, test quickly with real customers, form the company, and hand it to a long-term CEO once it is ready to raise. 
 You are the single accountable owner from start to handover. This is a hands-on operating role, not  an advisory one. You push forward when the evidence supports the venture and recommend  stopping early when it doesn't. 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
 Build  
 Take a validated concept and start executing from week one 
 Lead the product build with a small cross-functional team 
 Use AI and no-code tools to ship product, research and assets quickly 
 Set clear owners, deadlines and weekly milestones for every workstream 
 Validate  
 Launch an MVP and measure real behaviour: usage, conversion, payment and retention;Run short test-and-learn cycles and drop what the data doesn't support 
 Build the evidence case for continued investment 
 Recommend stopping the venture early if traction isn't there 
 External Relationships  
 Lead conversations with partners, early customers, suppliers and service providers 
 Drive early business development and first commercial deals 
 Manage contractors and specialists who don't report to you directly 
 Keep leadership and investors informed with regular, concise updates 
 Company Formation  
 Set up the legal entity, payments and core operating systems 
 Put basic finance, legal and reporting processes in place 
 Recruit the venture's first hires 
 Document decisions, systems and metrics so the business can run without you 
 Transition  
 Help recruit the venture's long-term CEO 
 Hand over the business cleanly and on schedule 
 Flag risks early to studio leadership before they cost time or money 
 Share lessons learned to improve how the studio builds future ventures 
 SUCCESS METRICS  
 MVP live with paying or active users within the first 90 days. 
 Clear traction evidence that supports further investment, or an early, well-reasoned stop  recommendation 
 Consistent weekly delivery across all work streams 
 Entity, payments and first hires in place on schedule 
 Long-term CEO hired and handover completed within the agreed timeline MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE 
 Built or led a venture from zero as a founder, early operator or EIR 
 A track record of fast, disciplined execution against a plan 
 Daily, practical use of AI tools to build, research and ship 
 Led small cross-functional teams, including contractors and external partners — Made the call to stop or pivot a product when the data required it 
 CORE COMPETENCIES  
 Execution  
 Speed with structure 
 End-to-end ownership of outcomes 
 Judgement  
 Decides on data, not opinion 
 Comfortable making hard calls early 
 Leadership & Communication  
 Leads without formal authority 
 Clear, proactive written communication 
 6+ years of experience in startup operations, venture building, general management, or a comparable operating role, ideally spanning more than one company.
 Direct, hands-on experience taking at least one company from zero to launch, not just supporting someone else's launch, but owning it.
 Strong working knowledge of AI tools and agentic workflows, with a track record of using them to replace team-based work, not just accelerate individual productivity.
 Experience designing or operating a structured process for de-risking new initiatives—stage gates, funnel management, or comparable venture-building systems.
 Hands-on experience managing execution across multiple work streams, products, or business lines simultaneously without relying on a large team.
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide concise, honest assessments of portfolio or business health.
 Comfortable operating as an independent contractor, with compensation aligned to scope and impact rather than a traditional salary ladder.
 WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE
 Starts shipping in the first week 
 Brings evidence, not opinions 
 Every work stream has an owner and a deadline 
 Surfaces problems before they grow 
 Stops a venture early when the data says so 
 Hands over a business that runs without them 
CANDIDATE SNAPSHOT
 A former founder or early operator who has taken a product from zero to paying customers — Builds with AI tools every day and ships before polishing 
 Comfortable leading people they don't directly employ 
 Wants to build multiple companies, not just one 
 Motivated by results, not titles
 Fully remote. No office, no commute, just you, the operating system, and wherever you do your best work.

 JadeClass Education Singapore Writing and Analysis courses provide enrichment education to bright students who already have a good command of the English language and are focusing on their written English with the goal of continuing their education abroad. Our students vary in age from 6-16 and are carefully screened for English level, behavior, and motivation. We focus on teaching concrete skills that will help students in their learning endeavors.
 IMPORTANT: We will not consider your application without a video introduction!!!
 Job Responsibilities 
 Our Writing and Analysis courses place one teacher with a group of up to eight students for a semester length course of study covering a topic such as story analysis, story writing, persuasive writing, narrative writing, analytical writing, and literature analysis. 
 Lesson materials are provided by our design team and are classroom-ready: all teachers have to do is review them and teach! Grading and student support outside of the classroom is provided by our in-house staff – everything from presentations and in-class activities to homework, tests and keys with standardized comments are created during the development process so that the course can be taught and supported independently of its creators.
 ·         Develop and deliver well-planned, engaging online classes in a 1 on 8 format 
 ·         Create, test, and revise lesson materials conforming to JadeClass standards
 ·         Commit to developing a full course of 15 lessons
 Applicant Requirements 
 ·         Able to guarantee preparation for and attendance at each scheduled meeting
 ·         Fun personality, talkative
 ·         Logical, able to explain concepts clearly and simply
 ·         A good imitator, able to emulate our style
 ·         Neat and professional appearance
 ·         Positive attitude
 ·         Malleable, willing to change to meet standards
 ·         Perfect oral grammar and clear enunciation
 Schedule 
 Development meetings can take place any day of the week online on the ClassIn (classin.com) platform between the hours of 08:00 and 20:00 UTC +8 (Singapore time). Lessons take place on the weekends during the fall and spring, and Monday-Saturday during the summer. 
 For the Spring 2027 semester, classes will run from late February through late June with teaching days on Friday evenings, Saturdays, and Sundays.
 ·         February – June: Fri 16:30 – 20:30 (UTC+8)
 Sat, Sun 08:30 – 20:30 (UTC+8)
 Compensation 
 ·         360 USD per newly developed lesson – includes in-class materials as well as homework, grading keys, and supplementary materials
 ·         Teaching hours are paid separately – 75 USD per 90 minute lesson
 ·         Remuneration is through Wise (wise.com) between the 10th and the 12th of each month.
 Technology Requirements 
 ·         Fast & stable internet connection (³ 20 Mbps)
 ·         Modern, reliable computer (~10,000+ on www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php) 
 Application Process 
 If you are interested in applying, please send the following to us at teaching@jadeclass.com :
 ·         Your resume
 ·         A link to your introduction video (Vimeo, YouTube, Google, or other safe platforms). The video can be 1-2 minutes in length, telling us a bit about your education and teaching background. If you send us a video file instead of a link, please make sure it is smaller than 20MB. 
 ·         Where you saw our job posting 
 ·         The name of the position for which you wish to apply 
 Please understand that due to the high volume of applications, we are only able to consider applicants who submit all the information listed above. Thank you for your interest in JadeClass Education!

The Work
The Data Scientist, Growth leads the design, development, deployment, and operationalization of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that support growth, customer experience, and commercial decision-making. The role translates ambiguous business problems into measurable data science solutions, with a focus on pricing, customer engagement, recommendation systems, experimentation, and model-driven decision support. 
The role works across the full analytical lifecycle, from problem framing and exploratory analysis through model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and production implementation. It also contributes to the modernization, migration, and scaling of machine learning assets and data workflows across cloud platforms and enterprise analytical environments. 

The Core Responsibilities: Lead machine learning model development for growth initiatives, including pricing, customer engagement, recommendation systems, propensity modelling, net promoter score, and related decisioning use cases. 
 • Design and maintain scalable data pipelines, feature engineering frameworks, and workflows for model training, scoring, monitoring, backtesting, and reporting. 
 • Develop and evaluate experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing, holdout analysis, uplift measurement, causal inference, and incrementality measurement. 
 • Perform feature engineering, model selection, validation, calibration, and performance monitoring. 
 • Partner with product, engineering, analytics, marketing, and business teams to define success measures, prioritize opportunities, and operationalize model outputs. 
 • Lead or contribute to migration and modernization of models, analytical assets, pipelines, and workflows, including the transition from Microsoft Fabric and Azure to Google Cloud Platform. 
 • Assess model dependencies and recommend whether assets should be migrated, refactored, rebuilt, consolidated, or retired. 
 • Design production-ready machine learning solutions, including deployment pipelines, automated retraining, monitoring, and performance tracking. 
 • Apply software engineering, data engineering, and machine learning operations practices, including modular design, version control, testing, automation, reproducibility, documentation, and code quality. 
 • Validate migrated or rebuilt solutions by reconciling data, features, model results, and business outputs. 
 • Communicate model and experiment findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 • Create reusable analytical frameworks, shared code libraries, notebooks, and production-ready assets. 
 • Mentor team members and support knowledge transfer and analytical excellence.
Let's Talk About You: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. 
 • Six or more years of total experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or a closely related discipline. 
 • Strong proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language, statistical analysis, Spark or similar distributed technologies, and scalable data processing. 
 • Experience building, validating, deploying, monitoring, and governing machine learning models in production or production-adjacent environments. 
 • Strong understanding of experimental design, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and measurement frameworks. 
 • Experience with cloud analytical environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Amazon Web Services, or similar platforms. 
 • Working knowledge of Git-based development, code review, automated testing, dependency management, and continuous integration and deployment. 
 • Experience with customer growth, personalization, pricing, recommendation systems, retention, or similar business applications. 
 • Advanced analytical problem-solving and sound judgment in ambiguous situations. 
 • Ability to explain technical information, trade-offs, migration risks, and insights to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. 
 • Preferred: experience with cloud migrations, Vertex AI or equivalent capabilities, modern machine learning platforms, Docker, infrastructure as code, observability, orchestration, and automated retraining.

Jobber exists to serve small business owners—and our employer brand reflects that mission. Our customers are hard-working, hands-on entrepreneurs in industries like landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, and cleaning. The Product:

You’ll work across our rapidly-growing Communications products at Jobber. Receptionist, our headline Voice AI product, is the fastest-growing product at Jobber will be your primary focus. It’s the clearest expression of where we think this company goes next. In under two years it went from nothing to a multi-million dollar run-rate business, and today it answers thousands of calls a week for plumbers, cleaners, electricians, and landscapers who would otherwise have missed them. For a small home service business, a missed call isn't a missed notification. It’s missed revenue or a customer left in a lurch.

The Role:

You’ll lead the product strategy and execution for Jobber’s Voice products: products designed to help small service businesses to stay on top of their phone calls and keep their business moving even when they’re in a crawlspace or on a ladder.

We are looking for a product manager to take Receptionist from early, high-conviction customers to the majority of small businesses who could benefit from it.  Ultimately, you're building a business, not a feature. Jobber’s Voice product answers the phone and takes a message. Then it books the job, follows up on the quote, calls the customer back, and takes action inside Jobber on the service provider's behalf. Every new capability we ship is a new reason customers depend on us. You'll own the roadmap that takes us from receptionist to something much closer to an office manager.

The Product Manager will:

 - Turn Receptionist from a product early adopters love into one the majority of Jobber’s customers rely on daily.

 - Define and execute the roadmap for Receptionist and new Voice products balancing short-term wins with long-term innovation.

 - Deeply understand small business owners and office managers, synthesizing market, regulatory, and customer data into smart product decisions.

 - Prioritize user and business impact, ensuring every product decision drives value for Jobber’s small business customers.

 - Collaborate with domain experts across Voice AI, telephony and communications products to launch best-in-class products.

 - Act as the voice of the customer, especially for small business owners navigating an overflowing inbox.

 - Set the foundation for multi-product strategy, as we incorporate a full suite of communications and scale the business and team

 - Owned a revenue line — attach rate, pricing, or packaging — rather than engagement metrics alone.

At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands. 
 Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region. 
 We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done. 
 Role overview 
 Our team develops the AI assistant built into Poka. Workers and supervisors use it every day on manufacturing floors. We build it with prompts, tools, information retrieval and agents.
 As a quality assurance (QA) specialist on this team, you make sure what we ship works: the assistant's answers and the features around it. You do it with automation, AI and tools you build, not with manual testing. You work with the devs, the product team and the design team to define what "good" means, then you build the evals, automated tests and tools that check it.
 How this is different from traditional QA 
 No manual test passes. If something needs to be checked more than once, you automate it, with code, AI or whatever tool fits.
 A large part of what you test has no single answer. The same question can get 50 good answers phrased differently, and the assistant can answer differently from one run to the next. You help define what "good" means and measure it.
 You write Python every week.
 If you're looking for a role focused on test plans and manual regression testing, this isn't it.
 What you'll be responsible for 
 Automating QA for the team's features and building the tools that make it easier, including ways for non-developers to add evals and analyze the results.
 Building and maintaining eval suites based on real usage: actual user questions, expected behavior and the edge cases that show up in production.
 Defining with the team what a good answer looks like for our users, writing scoring rubrics and using LLM-as-judge where it makes sense, calibrated against human-labeled samples.
 Running regression checks in CI every time we change a prompt, a tool, retrieval or the Claude model version, covering answer quality, cost and speed. You build the guardrails, evals and tests that tell us whether a release gets the green light or not.
 Reviewing real conversations and grouping failures into patterns: made-up answers, wrong tool calls, missed context, inappropriate tone. Then working with developers to turn them into fixes.
 Contributing to adversarial testing: prompt injection, data leaking between customers, getting the assistant to do things it shouldn't.
 Doing timeboxed exploratory testing on features that change what the assistant can decide or do, like new agents, tools or actions, including checking that actions stay safe when something fails or gets retried.
 Joining feature kickoffs to help define acceptance criteria, including AI-specific ones.
 What you bring 
 AEC, DEC or BAC in a field related to the position, or equivalent experience
 2 to 4 years of relevant experience
 A background in test automation or as an SDET
 You're comfortable with several programming languages, including Python and TypeScript
 Real curiosity about how LLMs behave and why they fail
 You're comfortable judging quality when there's no single answer, and explaining your reasoning
 Curiosity about our users' world. You can't judge an answer without understanding what a supervisor on a manufacturing floor actually needs.
 Assets 
 You've helped set up an eval harness, even in a personal project
 Experience using AI tools to speed up testing
 Basic statistics: pass rates, variance, sample size
 Experience in security or adversarial testing
 Knowledge of the test pyramid and the shift-left approach
 B2B experience or experience on industrial platforms
 Knowledge of Jira
 The technologies you'll use 
 Python
 TypeScript
 Claude Code
 Eval framework (promptfoo)
 AWS
 Docker
 And many others

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. Security isn't a feature at 1Password. It is the product. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape security strategy across the company, working with Security Engineering, who hold one of the highest technical bars in the industry, and with the product teams building everything our customers touch.


You'll be the bridge. You'll understand cryptographic and architectural detail well enough to earn the trust of our security engineers, and you'll translate what matters into clear priorities for feature teams. Just as importantly, you'll bring a deep respect for the customer: a security control nobody can stand to use makes everyone less safe. You'll help us find the design that's both rigorous and usable, and have the credibility to say so in a room full of experts



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with product teams on security early. Work with PMs and feature teams to understand their upcoming roadmaps, identify security requirements and threat-model implications before designs are locked, and make sure those needs are visible, prioritized, and resourced.

 - Align Security Engineering with product strategy. Translate feature-team needs into prioritized security work, and make Security Engineering's priorities legible to the rest of the company so tradeoffs are made in the open.

 - Own an independent security roadmap. Set direction for platform-level security investments, such as key management and recovery, the cryptographic foundations of our zero-knowledge architecture, authentication, and our long-term readiness for post-quantum cryptography.

 - Lead our strategy for the AI era. Define how 1Password approaches agentic access to credentials, secrets for non-human identities and AI agents, and the trust models emerging around tools and protocols like MCP.

 - Balance risk and usability with evidence. Help security engineers weigh real-world risk against user friction, using adoption, support, and telemetry data alongside threat models. Shipping with accepted, documented residual risk is sometimes the right call, and you'll help us make and defend those decisions.

 - Represent 1Password to the security community. Engage with security researchers and our bug bounty program, speak at conferences, and contribute to the wider conversation about where credential security is heading.

 - Raise the bar for product work. Coach PMs on security thinking, challenge assumptions constructively, and set the standard for how security-critical product work gets done.




OUR PHILOSOPHY ON PRODUCT CONSISTS OF FIVE CORE PILLARS:



 - Focus and execution: Can you ship quickly and measure results?

 - Customer empathy: Are you motivated first and foremost to solve customer problems?

 - Effective communication: Can you bring the entire organization, horizontally and vertically, along on the journey?

 - Go to market: Can you understand and drive business outcomes through product decisions?

 - Technology: Articulating how our technology beats our competitors



Product Managers play a highly visible role at 1Password and are critical to the development and execution of our product strategy. As PMs, we are responsible for setting and championing a high bar for our products. At the Principal level, you also set the standard for how product work gets done. You coach, you challenge assumptions, and you make the whole team better. You must excel at prioritization, collaboration, and communication, while holding yourself and others accountable for measuring quality and business results.  - 10+ years of product management experience, including significant time on security-critical products or platforms in a SaaS environment. We'll also strongly consider exceptional candidates with equivalent depth, such as security engineers or researchers who moved into product.

 - Deep, demonstrable knowledge of security fundamentals: cryptography, authentication protocols, identity and access management, zero-knowledge and end-to-end encrypted system design, and threat modeling.

 - Experience making and defending risk-based tradeoffs, and explaining them clearly to engineers, executives, and customers.

 - Experience setting strategy at the platform or infrastructure level, and influencing roadmaps you don't own without formal authority.

 - Communication that scales from a security research paper to an executive briefing without losing precision in either direction.

 - A strong point of view on how the security landscape is shifting, and the ability to connect it to concrete roadmap decisions.


STRONG PLUS

 - Standing in the security community, through conference talks, publications, research, open-source work, or standards participation.

 - Hands-on experience with AI security: agent identity and authorization, prompt injection, secrets management for automated systems.

 - Experience with compliance and certification regimes such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, or FIPS.

 - Prior work in vulnerability disclosure, incident response, or threat intelligence that gives you a practitioner's intuition.

 - Experience running or working closely with a bug bounty program or researcher community.

 - Empowerment to set long-term security product strategy and drive it through execution

 - Workflow Orchestration: Implement durable, multi-step verification workflows using a workflow engine to guarantee reliable execution across service and vendor boundaries.

Le portefeuille de tournées dans les Amériques est l'un des moteurs commerciaux les plus dynamiques du Cirque du Soleil — et ce poste en est le pilote. Développer et exécuter les stratégies de ventes de groupe et de distribution alignées sur les plans d'affaires annuels, les conditions du marché et les objectifs de revenus du portefeuille

Diriger un programme de ventes sortantes de groupe à fort volume et encadrer l'équipe tout au long du cycle de vente complet, en maximisant les prospects entrants, les références et les comptes existants
Développer des relations de haut niveau avec les comptes de groupe clés et piloter les visites de marchés, salons professionnels, tournées de familiarisation et initiatives clients qui génèrent des prospects et des revenus
Identifier, évaluer, négocier, contractualiser et intégrer de nouveaux partenaires de distribution en collaboration avec les équipes Juridique, Finance, Revenue Management, Billetterie, Marketing, Numérique et Technologie

Analyser les données de ventes, de canaux, de clients et de marchés, et diriger les prévisions, les revues de pipeline, les rapports de performance, la planification budgétaire et les bilans d'affaires destinés à la direction
Fixer les objectifs de l'équipe et mener des séances régulières de coaching et d'évaluation de la performance, en utilisant les données Salesforce pour renforcer la prospection disciplinée, les prévisions, les suivis et la prise en charge des opportunités
Allouer les ressources entre les marchés et les canaux, établir des pratiques cohérentes à l'échelle du portefeuille, et soutenir le recrutement, l'intégration, la planification de la relève et le développement professionnel
Agir en tant que liaison principale des ventes avec les équipes internes, les opérations de spectacle, les agences, les partenaires et autres parties prenantes spécifiques au marché
Représenter le Cirque du Soleil lors des réunions clients, des revues de partenaires, des salons professionnels, des événements de l'industrie et des visites de marchés, et diriger des projets spéciaux selon les besoins

 Workana is the largest remote work platform for talent in Latin America. Our division focuses on matching exceptional professionals with leading and innovative companies around the globe.

 Our client is a premier global financial institution committed to driving innovation and technical excellence across its core banking and digital services. They are looking for an experienced AI Lead Solutions Architect to drive strategic artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives, architect scalable solutions, and mentor engineering teams.
 This is a hybrid opportunity for professionals based in Toronto, Canada, working closely with an international team in an English-speaking environment.

 As an AI Lead / Solutions Architect, you will lead R&D efforts and technical execution for complex AI/ML applications in financial services, including document intelligence, automated decisioning systems, and multi-agent workflows. You will design end-to-end architectures from model design to scalable production deployment while driving technical innovation using modern AI techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and transformer models.

 Initial interview with Workana's recruiting team;

 Final interview with C-level.

 Architect and deploy end-to-end AI/ML solutions from model design to scalable production environments using modern frameworks.

 Drive technical innovation through experimentation with RAG, multi-agent systems, and transformer architectures.

 Coordinate cross-functional technical delivery across ML engineers, backend developers, data teams, and business stakeholders.

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

 

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement. We’re seeking a talented and collaborative Senior Product Manager to join us in building innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.

 

As a Senior Product Manager at Procurify, you will play a key role in defining and delivering high-impact solutions within one of our core product areas. You will work in a fast-paced, AI-Native product and engineering environment. You will partner closely with your triad of engineering and design, and collaborate across the triple diamond to move quickly from concept to delivery.

 

We are looking for someone who is driven to solve important problems for customers and motivated by the opportunity to create real impact. You thrive in a collaborative environment and see cross-functional partnership as essential to building great products. You will work closely with teams across the company to ensure we are solving the right problems with purpose and clarity.







WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON



Focus on outcomes, not just features

 - You will be responsible for driving meaningful business and customer results. Your work will align with strategic priorities and guide your team to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.



Building great strategy through domain expertise

 - You will be responsible for strategic direction and effective decision-making in your product domains. This will be achieved through your depth of knowledge in your domain and through facilitation with experts within the company.



Act as a strong customer advocate

 - You will represent the voice of the customer through deep curiosity, insight, and empathy. You will champion their needs and ensure that every solution improves their experience and drives value.



Work fast in an AI-Native environment

 - You will operate within a modern product development process that uses rapid prototyping, fast experimentation, and AI tools. You will help identify how AI can unlock better solutions, faster.



Collaborate across the company

 - You will work closely within your product triad and partner across every part of the business. You will build alignment, share context, and ensure that product decisions are grounded in both customer insight and cross-functional collaboration.



Lead with clarity and purpose

 - You will approach product challenges with a strong sense of ownership and focus. You will drive decisions that balance customer needs, technical realities, and business goals, always aiming to deliver exceptional results.



Contribute to product direction

 - You will help shape the product strategy and inform roadmap decisions in your area, you will be responsible for delivering results aligned with its goals.

 


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience in SaaS, fintech, or related industries.

 - Proven product ownership experience within the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. You must have deep expertise in at least one core domain:
   
   - Procurement (eg, purchase requisitions, PO management, supplier onboarding, sourcing)
   
   - Accounts Payable (eg, invoice data capture, approval workflows, payment execution)

 - Proven ability to deliver high-impact business and customer outcomes in fast-moving environments

 - Experience working in empowered, cross-functional triads with engineering and design

 - Familiarity with AI-Native development practices and rapid experimentation

 - Strong communication skills and a highly collaborative mindset

 - Analytical thinker with a focus on solving the right problems

 - Clear sense of domain ownership and ability to align work to strategic goals

 - Passion for building meaningful products as part of a high-performing team

 - Excellent project management skills to effectively run discovery, design, and development of initiatives in parallel.

 - For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.





WHY PROCURIFY?




HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world — across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software — to manage over $30B in spend. We recently closed $50M in Series C funding to help us strengthen our core offering, launch new payment capabilities, and provide customers with an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/.



BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK



We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

 - Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!

 - Unlimited responsible time off: Work hard, play harder. All team members can take advantage of our unlimited responsible time off policy.

 - Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

 - Community initiatives: We have a strong commitment to giving back to our communities, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns.

 - Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

 - DEI initiatives: We regularly run a diversity, equity, and inclusion roundtable where we host guest speakers and tackle the topics that matter.

 - Base Salary Range: $145,000-$160,000 CAD (This range is dependent on experience and not inclusive of any bonus, commission, benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package).





WORK WITH AN AMAZING TEAM

We’ve welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we’re here to embrace them!

 




LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

 

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.



To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:

 - Get to know our team through our Meet Us Monday videos https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaADg-JHT1trtbIv6MH6rhv2wJq_ihJ_B

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
 Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
 To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:
 No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
 No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment.
 Please always verify communications:
 Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address.
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to support@zirtual.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

WANTED: A Salesperson With a Servant's Heart Who Picks Up the Phone Before Anyone Tells Them To
 Client Account Manager, Wealth Without Wall Street
 Most salespeople fall into one of two camps.
 The first camp can close, but clients feel like a number the minute the ink dries. 
 The second camp is lovely to talk to, but they won't ask for the business, and they let the phone sit there like it bites.
 We don't want either one. We want the rare person in the middle: someone who serves first, sells because they care, and dials without a second thought.
 Here's why. Over the years, thousands of business owners, investors and families have trusted Wealth Without Wall Street to help them build wealth outside the stock market. We do it with Infinite Banking (whole life insurance built for cash flow) and passive income education.
 Our strategists are very good at designing and placing policies. But once a policy is in force, too many of those clients go a long time without hearing from us. That's money left on the table. Worse, it's people left on their own.
 That's where you come in.
 The job, in plain English: You'll own a book of existing clients and past prospects. Your job is to call them, serve them, and grow the relationship into new business.
 You'll:
 Pick up the phone. A lot. Your day revolves around real conversations, not emails you hope get answered
 Re-engage clients who haven't heard from us in a while, and past prospects who didn't finish the process
 Run policy reviews, answer questions about policy loans and PUAs, and quarterback service so every client feels looked after. Our ops team handles the paperwork
 Uncover opportunities (new capital, a business sale, a growing family) and ask for the next step. Then book the client with one of our IBC strategists
 Ask every happy client for referrals, and follow up until they turn into conversations
 Introduce clients to our Passive Income Lab when it fits
 Spot clients drifting away and get on the phone before they leave
 Log every call and next step in HubSpot, and own your weekly numbers: contacts, opportunities, referrals, cases
 Who should NOT apply: Don't apply if you'd rather send a text than make a call. Skip this if asking for a referral makes you squirm. And if you see clients as commissions with names attached, this isn't your seat. Our clients can tell, and so can we.
 Who you are: 
 A servant first. You genuinely want your clients to win, and it shows in how you listen
 Phone-fearless. You'd rather have 50 real conversations than send 500 emails
 Not afraid to ask. You ask for the meeting, the next step and the referral, because you believe in what you're offering
 Relentless on follow-up. Nobody has to remind you, and nothing falls through the cracks
 Motivated by results. You like knowing your numbers and you like beating them
 What you bring: 
 2+ years in sales, account management or client relationships, ideally in insurance, financial services or wealth management
 A track record of hitting targets while keeping clients happy (bring examples)
 Comfortable on phone and video calls all day
 CRM discipline (HubSpot a plus)
 Active life insurance license, or willingness to get licensed within 60 days 
 Understanding of whole life insurance or Infinite Banking is a big plus. If you don't have it, we'll teach you
 How to apply (read carefully, because this is the first test): 
 You need to follow the application form below to a T, miss something you are not going to be considered. Attention to detail in this role is super imporant.
 Along with your résumé, we are going to ask for a short video talking about yourself, your sales background, your client services background and about a time you served a client so well that it turned into more business or a referral. Tell us what you did and what came of it.
 Bonus points in your video if you start it out with the words "Serve First" in the first line so we know you read this whole thing.
 Finalists will do a short Culture Index survey and a live role-play call . If phone calls make you nervous, this is where we'll find out.
 $40,000 - $50,000 base salary, so you have stability while you build
 Uncapped commission on every new case and referral you generate [8% of each case you originate, plus referral/Lab bonus]
 Warm conversations, not cold strangers. Every name in your book already knows who we are. Some already bought, and some almost did
 Our strategists handle the technical close, so you can focus on the relationship and the ask
 Paid licensing [if applicable] and full training on Infinite Banking, our service process and HubSpot
 A team that's growing fast, with a mission worth selling: helping families build wealth outside Wall Street

 About the role 
 Moonshot is recruiting a Head of AI Safety to lead the delivery, development, and growth of our AI Safety portfolio. The role combines Moonshot's expertise in violence prevention, behavioural risk, and online harms with the emerging practice of evaluating and improving the safety of AI systems. The portfolio addresses harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, child sexual exploitation, abuse and grooming (CSEA), mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teenagers.
 The Head of AI Safety will serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI companies, governments, and regulators. The role will work closely with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams. This is not an engineering or data-science role, but it is a hands-on position requiring the successful candidate to lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with evaluation methodologies, test scenarios, model responses, safety policies, and intervention frameworks. The role holds responsibility for client and partner relationships, project and staff management, methodological quality, and business development. The Head of AI Safety will build and maintain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including with governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, and civil society organizations.
 This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in Ontario, Canada, due to employment and regulatory requirements.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Applied AI Safety, Evaluation, and Advisory 
 Lead and quality-assure Moonshot's applied AI safety work across harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, CSEA, abuse and grooming, mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teens, using methods such as red teaming and adversarial evaluation of AI systems.
 Advise frontier AI companies on how to improve the safety of their models, products, policies, and intervention systems.
 Translate insights from psychologists, child-safety specialists, violence-prevention practitioners, safeguarding experts, and other subject-matter experts into clear, actionable guidance for model safety, policy, product, research, and engineering teams.
 Set the methodological approach for the portfolio, translating violence-prevention, safeguarding, and behavioural-risk expertise into structured and testable evaluation frameworks.
 Lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with test scenarios, model responses, scoring criteria, safety policies, and evaluation results.
 Identify patterns, edge cases, and potential safety failures, and develop practical recommendations for improving model behaviour and user protections.
 Maintain rigour and clear documentation across the team's technical deliverables, suitable for technical, government, and foundation audiences.
 Ensure work is delivered within a clear ethical framework and in compliance with contractual, legal, data protection, and ethics obligations.
 Identify, manage, and escalate operational, reputational, delivery, and partnership risks.
 Client & Partner Management 
 Serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI company partners, governments, regulators, and the wider ecosystem invested in AI safety.
 Build trusted relationships with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams.
 Build and sustain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, civil society organizations, and specialist practitioners.
 Represent Moonshot externally in meetings, briefings, workshops, and sector engagement, including with regulators and policymaker audiences.
 Team Leadership & Management 
 Provide direct leadership, coaching, and management to Moonshot's AI safety team.
 Foster a collaborative, accountable, and mission-driven team culture, with particular attention to wellbeing given the sensitive nature of the work.
 Support workforce planning, performance management, and professional development across the team.
 Ensure effective coordination with internal teams supporting the portfolio, including operations, finance, research, and technical teams.
 Portfolio Development & Growth 
 Develop Moonshot's AI safety portfolio, identifying strategic opportunities, partnerships, and funding.
 Lead proposal development, scoping, and renewals with technical credibility, using precise, defensible language suited to technical and government audiences.
 Develop repeatable methodologies, service offerings, and partnerships that allow the portfolio to grow while maintaining methodological rigour and delivery quality.
 Support external communications, publications, briefings, and thought leadership that establish Moonshot as a credible voice in applied AI safety.
 Oversee project planning, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.
 Essential: 
 Experience in trust & safety, online harms, or a closely related field such as violence prevention, safeguarding, or public health, and the ability to adapt that knowledge to AI systems.
 Curiosity about AI and the ability to build technical fluency quickly, enough to engage credibly with technical counterparts at AI companies. Much of this work is new, so comfort learning as you go matters more than existing AI safety expertise.
 Experience designing research, evaluation frameworks, or interventions for harm categories such as violent extremism, CSEA, self-harm and crisis, or targeted violence.
 Demonstrated experience managing projects, teams, budgets, partners, and clients, with strong people management skills.
 Excellent written communication, with experience producing credible (not promotional) material for government, foundation, or enterprise audiences.
 Comfort and demonstrated resilience working with highly sensitive or graphic content (CSEA, extremist material, crisis content), with awareness of wellbeing practices for this kind of work.
 Strong judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and sensitive stakeholder environments, including representing organizations externally.
